name: Information Security Governance
description: An information security governance framework must be established and maintained by the organization.

name: Asset Management
description: All information assets must be identified, classified, and inventoried.

name: Event Logging and Monitoring
description: Logging and monitoring must be implemented to detect and respond to security events.

name: Backup and Recovery
description: Backup and recovery procedures must be established and regularly tested.

name: Network Security
description: Network security controls including firewalls and segmentation must be implemented.
